label: Use classification and compliance first
details: Use GS1/NAPCS for category backbone and BIFMA/LEVEL for commercial furniture compliance/evidence.

label: Add retailer/product catalog references
details: IKEA and Wayfair are useful public/current catalog references, but full structured bulk access is not straightforward without APIs or third-party services.

label: Use BIM/spec directories for commercial furnishings
details: ARCAT, Sweets, BIMobject and BIM&CO are better for manufacturer/spec/BIM records than retail pricing.

label: Use commercial APIs where justified
details: Skulytics and third-party IKEA APIs can provide structured feeds, but treat them as paid/current offer sources with licensing concerns.

label: Separate offer rows from evidence rows
details: Retailer price/stock rows, BIFMA compliance rows, BIM/spec rows and product identity rows should stay separate but link through product identity and category.
